raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 0.3.21

package:
  name: vim-vint
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/v/vim-vint/vim-vint-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5dc59b2e5c2a746c88f5f51f3fafea3d639c6b0fdbb116bb74af27bf1c820d97

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - vint = vint:main

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python =${{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=36.2.2
  run:
    - ansicolor
    - chardet >=2.3.0
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pyyaml >=3.11
    - setuptools >=36.2.2
    - typing >=3.6.2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - vint
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python =${{ python_min }}
    script:
      - pip check
      - vint --help

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Lint tool for Vim script Language
  homepage: https://github.com/Kuniwak/vint
  repository: https://github.com/Kuniwak/vint

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - danielnachun
